title: File:Green's Windmill sundial 1265.JPG
author: Photograph by Clem Rutter, Rochester, Kent. (www.clemrutter.net).
description:
Green's Mill, Sneinton, Nottingham,  is a brick tower mill, in Sneinton, Nottingham,  with connections to George Green, the mathematician.

This is a photo of listed building number 1246256.


.The interior was destroyed in a fire in 1947, but it is operational again, using recovered equipment from similar styled mills.\n
The sundial is set for BST, while the camera is on GMT. The gnomon is set by hand- it throws a shadow until the correct time is reached.
